{{Otheruses|Grohl|more=Defense Force}}
The '''Grohl Sector Defense Force''' were the primary military body of the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]] in the waging years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]] was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in this unit.
